policy.advertised_operations: for every offered tool whose capability is not available:false, in tools_available order: ffprobe, epub_inspect, audiobook_inspect, arr_lookup {}; decode_sample {"at": o} for every advertised offset, then {"full": true} when the full decode is advertised as recorded, on request or a bounded run; audio_sample {"at": o, "stream": 0} for every advertised offset; frame_sample and ocr {"at": o} for every advertised offset, or, when the offsets are "any", the start of every recorded reading range and 0; a tool with no advertisement {} (windowed tools {"at": 0})
policy.revealed_candidates: every `available` link of the v3 open list over the case evidence plus all results served so far, and over the case evidence plus each single served result; ocr {"frame": name} for every frame a served frame_sample returned; up to 3 rounds
policy.excluded: a candidate equivalent to case evidence (it is already shown); candidates whose served result is unavailable
policy.witness: iterative deepening over sets of distinct served candidates, smallest first, in pool order; cost = calls + every extra page of the first message and of each witness result (pages counted by the real v3 session); a witness costs at most 6; at most 5000 checker evaluations per row
policy.satisfied: every diagnosis prerequisite of an accepted class and every action prerequisite of a supported action that class can take is met (insufficient_evidence: no other class and not healthy established); reference roles depend on the decision written and are assessed for written decisions only
policy.limits: replay only (no live collector); offsets outside the advertisement and frames other than those returned are not explored; stream arguments other than 0 are not explored; sets larger than six calls are not searched; free-text identity and M9 stay `unknown` to the checker
